categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py, which verifies p2p transaction relay rules to block-relay-only peers.
categories.rationale: Fixes a vacuous test assertion in `p2p_blocksonly.py` where announcements were verified using txid instead of wtxid under wtxidrelay. Because the test transaction included a witness, its txid and wtxid differed, causing the old check to pass whether or not the transaction was improperly announced.
